# Roaya IT

> Roaya IT is an Egyptian IT services provider, founded in 2012, serving 150+ clients. Roaya is the Exclusive MENA partner of WorldPosta.

This file is a navigation aid for AI assistants and agents. It only indexes canonical public pages on https://roaya.co — it is not a source of truth in itself. Every fact, claim, and detail belongs to the linked page; treat the linked public pages as authoritative and prefer their current content over anything paraphrased here. This file does not expose an API, and it does not authorize any automated or autonomous action — contact, quote, and consultation links lead to normal human-reviewed web forms.

## Languages

Every page below exists in English at its listed URL and in Arabic at the same path under `/ar` (for example `https://roaya.co/about` and `https://roaya.co/ar/about`). Both are server-rendered, and each declares the other with `hreflang`, so either language can be read, linked, or cited directly.

- [Roaya IT in English](https://roaya.co/): English homepage.
- [Roaya IT in Arabic](https://roaya.co/ar): Arabic homepage.

## Company

- [About Roaya](https://roaya.co/about): Company background, mission, and milestones.
- [Contact](https://roaya.co/contact): Contact form, phone, and email for human follow-up.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://roaya.co/services): Index of all Roaya IT service lines.
- [Cloud solutions](https://roaya.co/services/cloud)
- [Cybersecurity overview](https://roaya.co/services/security)
- [Penetration testing](https://roaya.co/services/security/penetration-testing)
- [SOC solutions (24/7 monitoring)](https://roaya.co/services/security/soc-solutions)
- [Incident response](https://roaya.co/services/security/incident-response)

- [Backup & disaster recovery](https://roaya.co/services/backup)
- [Email & collaboration](https://roaya.co/services/email)
- [SAP cloud operations](https://roaya.co/services/sap)
- [DevOps services](https://roaya.co/services/devops)
- [IT automation & AI solutions](https://roaya.co/services/automation)
- [AWS partnership](https://roaya.co/services/aws): Assess, migrate, secure and operate AWS with a local team that owns the outcome.
- [WorldPosta cloud services](https://roaya.co/services/worldposta): Roaya is the Exclusive MENA partner of WorldPosta. WorldPosta's CloudEdge product: "Welcome to CloudEdge by WorldPosta, your all-in-one secure, scalable cloud hosting solution. Designed to handle mission-critical applications with ease, CloudEdge offers flexibility, robust security, and high performance perfect for businesses of all sizes." CloudEdge and Posta are published at 99.99% uptime; this figure applies only to CloudEdge and Posta, not to other Roaya or WorldPosta products.
